summary.name: OpenClaw
summary.one_liner: OpenClaw is a self-hosted, open-source AI assistant gateway that runs on your own hardware and connects chat apps such as Telegram, Discord, Signal, Slack and WhatsApp to AI coding agents.
keywords: run ai assistant on my own computer
use_cases: Chat with an AI assistant from Telegram, Discord, Signal or WhatsApp
Run a private AI assistant on your own laptop or server
Share a team AI assistant gateway across messaging channels
Schedule recurring agent tasks with cron jobs and webhooks
Pair mobile devices as nodes for camera, screen and voice workflows
summary.what_it_does: OpenClaw runs a single Gateway process on your machine or a server that acts as the bridge between messaging apps and AI coding agents. Guided setup is provided through openclaw onboard, and the Gateway can be installed as a background service. Channels include Discord, iMessage, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp and WebChat, with more via channel plugins. It offers isolated sessions per agent, workspace or sender, image, audio and document handling, and a browser Control UI for chat, config and sessions. Automation is available through cron jobs, hooks and webhooks, and developers can write channel, provider and tool plugins against the plugin SDK.
notable: Single Gateway process serves every configured chat channel at once
Self-hosted with no hosted service in the middle; no paid tier and no telemetry by default beyond a version check
Developed by the OpenClaw Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3); MIT licensed
Pair iOS and Android nodes for camera, screen and voice-enabled workflows
caveats: Requires Node 24.22.1+ or Node 26.12.1+ (Node 26 recommended) and an API key from your chosen AI provider
Best quality and security depends on using the strongest latest-generation model you can access
Channel plugins such as Matrix, Nostr, Twitch and Zalo are installed on demand rather than bundled
